tasks.short: Discuss developmental problems and recommend product modifications

steps.what: Retrieve the current model drawings and developmental problem information
Consult engineering personnel about developmental problems and practical constraints
Develop practical recommendations for product modifications
Annotate the proposed modifications for the engineers' use
Communicate the modification recommendation to engineering personnel

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} drawing references and annotation headings for the modification proposal engineers already use. The model maker retains the engineering conversation and practical recommendation, checking the exact annotation before communicating it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating the current drawing and repeating its identifiers can add minor clerical preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document views and annotation fields can remove those repeated actions.
tasks.still_hard: The solution depends on manufacturability and the development problem.
tasks.human_edge: Explain practical constraints and identify a workable modification.
tasks.altitude: The consultation remains substantially unchanged, with slightly clearer source references.

reach.learn: Link the recommendation to the correct drawing version.

evidence.claim: Native drawing references and annotation headings could remove minor repeated navigation and identifiers; the consultation and time estimates remain unmeasured.

assumptions: This scenario includes an existing annotated proposal actually used by engineers; no meeting log or trailing record is introduced. Purely oral recommendations have no annotation saving.

Engineering staff maintain current drawing versions and identify the development problem. S1 includes retrieving and checking them. The model maker produces recommendations in s3 and captures annotations in s4; missing drawings or unresolved constraints require manual clarification.
The document view removes only 1 hour of repeated navigation. Annotation headings remove only 1 hour of repeated drawing identifiers, retaining the actual technical markup.
Native document features come first. Ordinary author saves remain retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Whether drawing references are already directly available.
research_questions: Observe current consultations and measure repeated navigation and identifiers without adding documentation.

already_counted.description: Consult engineers and develop the recommendation

incremental.description: Maintain drawing references and annotation headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact modification proposal, drawing version and engineering recipients; changed technical content requires checking again before communication.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=98, gross 2 minus 1 upkeep gives central net 1. Conservative case: weak version links retain all 10 lookup hours and reusable identifiers retain 9/10 annotation hours plus 80 fixed: 99 retained, 1 gross minus 1 =0. Compatible drawing metadata retain 9.5 lookup and 9 annotation hours plus 80 fixed: 98.5 retained, 1.5 gross minus 1 =0.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Use CAD and CAM to fabricate model parts

steps.what: Interpret model part geometry, material and manufacturing requirements
Create model part geometry in computer-aided design software
Prepare the model part program in computer-aided manufacturing software
Run the existing manufacturing program simulation
Check the program, setup and simulation for the intended fabrication
Transfer the checked fabrication program to the machine controller
outputs: controller program for the identified machine

steps.what: Set up and operate the equipment to fabricate model parts
inputs: controller program for the identified machine

steps.what: Check the fabricated parts against the model requirements

tasks.design: Configure reusable geometry templates and verified tooling libraries in the existing design/manufacturing software ({OTHER}). The model maker retains part interpretation, program checking, controller transfer, physical fabrication and part assessment; native configuration reduces only repeated geometry and setup entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated features and tooling definitions may be rebuilt for similar model parts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and tool libraries permit selective reuse with part-specific checks.
tasks.still_hard: Novel geometry, stock conditions and tooling constraints can make a reused setup inappropriate.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise practical machining problems and assess the fabricated part.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated digital setup while retaining manufacturing responsibility.

reach.learn: Bind templates and tool definitions to the intended machine and part version.

evidence.claim: Native design templates and manufacturing tool libraries can reuse repeated geometry and settings; this task's saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: OTHER means existing computer-aided design and manufacturing software. The boundary includes digital preparation, controller transfer, physical fabrication and conformity checking. No new trailing production log is added.

Engineering supplies the part drawing, material and tolerances, checked in s1. The model maker produces geometry in s2 and program/setup in s3. Existing tooling owners maintain tool identifiers, dimensions and machine/postprocessor compatibility; retained s3 time checks these and enters missing values manually.

Geometry templates remove 2 hours of repeated features from 25 design hours. Tool libraries remove 5 hours of repeated definitions from 25 programming hours. Existing calculation and simulation runtime earns no labour saving.
Native configuration comes first. Author saves remain retained without approval; the separate controller transfer gate binds the exact program. No autonomous machining change is proposed.
unknowns: How often geometry and tool settings genuinely repeat.
Whether templates match the installed machine and postprocessor versions.
research_questions: Compare preparation on repeat and novel parts, including template correction and physical trial effort.

already_counted.description: Check simulations and assess fabricated parts

incremental.description: Maintain geometry templates and compatible tooling libraries

approvals.approved_version: Exact program checksum/version, setup, tool definitions, postprocessor and target machine checked in s5; any changed program or destination voids that check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=93, gross 7 minus 2 upkeep gives central net 5. Conservative case: novel geometry retains all 25 design hours and limited compatible tooling retains 23/25 programming hours plus 50 fixed: 98 retained, 2 gross minus 2 =0. Compatible repeated features retain 24 design and 21 programming hours plus 50 fixed: 95 retained, 5 gross minus 2 =3.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep model-making judgement, engineering consultation and physical fabrication while reducing specific repeated digital preparation.
reach: Compare drawing and tooling conventions with engineers and machining programmers.
role.ambitious_version: Traceable model preparation with practical manufacturing responsibility retained by the model maker.
